review_method: Read primary event labels, independently retrieved both endpoint source revisions and surrounding lines with git show, verified all 26 endpoint hashes, checked cross-file source deletion/new destination occurrence, and reviewed source-only change statistics. No detector outputs accessed.
review_scope: Second adjudication of the 13 proposed positive events only. No independent exhaustive re-inventory of ordinary windows or all large extraction revisions.
limitations: Second AI corroboration, not human adjudication or independent target discovery.
Five standalone typedefs are legitimate complete targets but should remain identifiable by construct kind; do not describe all twelve whole constructs as whole functions.
IPP extraction events are correlated within three campaigns; event count is not the number of independent revisions.
For the JPEG two-statement permutation, the declared one-event convention prevents double counting and does not establish a uniquely privileged moved side.

events.identity_reason: Same uniquely named complete construct disappears from source file and appears once in previously absent destination file, with byte equality or only visible whitespace changes.
events.hierarchy_assessment: Standalone namespace/file-scope typedef, outside neighboring function/class/struct bodies. It transfers as its own complete declaration; association with a larger IPP extraction campaign does not make it a syntactic descendant of a moved function. No whole namespace is labeled as a moved parent.
